method: For degenerate UV-area cap vertices, construct a unit tangent perpendicular to the exported normal; preserve handedness. Lossless exact-attribute weld/dedup/prune, then KHR_mesh_quantization: position14bit/normal12bit/UV12bit where normalized; tiled UVs remain float32. A second exact weld follows quantization. Submillimetre positions over this courtyard. Native Three support; no Draco/decoder, material or animation removal.
